questions.question: How much lower is the average review score for delivered orders that arrived late than for delivered orders that arrived on time?
questions.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         (order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) AS is_late
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.review_score, d.is_late
  FROM order_reviews r
  JOIN delivered d ON d.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT round(avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE is_late)::numeric, 2) AS late_avg_score,
       round(avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_late)::numeric, 2) AS on_time_avg_score,
       round((avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_late) - avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE is_late))::numeric, 2) AS score_drop_for_late
